scope: New independent piControl/source-thermal dependencies only; no observation-assembly rerun, regression, attribution or headline scoring

operativeSource.readBeforeSelection: load_PiC_CMIP6, filter_PiControl, load_ERF_CMIP6 and GWI run_FaIR invocation; prior focused physical and observation source evidence read
operativeSource.knownMissingRunner: The retained current recursive tree has no models/FaIR_V2/FaIRv2_0_0_alpha1/fair/fair_runner.py. Do not claim supported FaIR2.2.4 reproduces absent code.

sequence: Exact operative data/piControl/CMIP6/README.txt for dataset-specific rights and source metadata
Exact operative models/AR5_IR.py for independent retained thermal-method investigation
At most one source-specific rights page explicitly linked by the returned control README
Only if terms explicitly permit the intended local derivation: first lexicographic MAG source from already-retained tree (AS-RCEC/TaiESM1/piControl/r1i1p1f1), fixed independently of control outcomes
At most one metadata/code dependency explicitly linked by the returned thermal source; no general search or ensemble sweep
boundedAcquisition.rightsGate: No full ensemble or control data acquisition without explicit dataset-specific permitted-use evidence. Generic repository code/output licenses do not license CMIP6 controls or Chris forcing ensembles. Unknown terms stop acquisition.
boundedAcquisition.noForcingLfsDownload: Underlying forcing ensembles remain unfetched unless their exact data-specific rights are independently established within this bound. LFS pointer visibility is not permission.

fixedSourceControlAssembly.sample: One source only if rights permit; never call it complete GWI control ensemble
fixedSourceControlAssembly.sourceSegmentRule: 50 percent overlapping positional segments: step n_yrs//2=88; segments=(N-(n_yrs-n_yrs//2))//(n_yrs//2); each exact 176-position segment
fixedSourceControlAssembly.baseline: Each source slice first end_pi-start_pi=50 positions, not 51-year observation median offset
fixedSourceControlAssembly.filter: Exact strict valid 3-year smooth max<0.3, min>-0.3, span>0.06 and valid 30-year smooth max<0.1, min>-0.1
fixedSourceControlAssembly.identity: Retain institution/model/experiment/member/grid/version/variable/source years, exact hash, positional slice bounds and raw source coordinates
fixedSourceControlAssembly.missingRule: Source uses dropna before positional slicing; do not silently make a broken calendar continuous. Reject gaps or nonannual/multiple World columns unless explicitly qualified.
fixedSourceControlAssembly.tests: Independent source-equation segmentation/filter residuals; duplicates, units, unsupported terms, absent/gapped/nonfinite years and identity collisions fail closed

thermalInvestigationBeforeOutcomes.parameters: All 28 retained author configurations, 3 q/d terms each; d years, q K per W/m2
thermalInvestigationBeforeOutcomes.sourceComparison: If returned source contains executable compatible q/d response, compare exact independently coded recurrence to that source before any historical or attribution use; preserve any discrepancy and timing convention.
thermalInvestigationBeforeOutcomes.forcingIfNeeded: Already-retained actual 1750-2025 IGCC p50 ERF only for a deterministic source-method diagnostic, never a joint forcing ensemble or inverse emissions reconstruction
thermalInvestigationBeforeOutcomes.residuals: Report per-configuration maximum absolute and RMSE source-method discrepancies with annual versus boundary timing explicit; do not optimize parameters or fit target offsets
thermalInvestigationBeforeOutcomes.noAutomaticEquivalence: Agreement with a sibling AR5 impulse-response helper alone is not proof of missing alpha1 runner equivalence or a GSAT/GMST conversion
